name: status-pills
title: Status Pills
description: A row of short facts about the page, set as pills: "Reviewed", "9 facts", "38 sources", "4 min read". Built to sit on a brand band (`<Section tone="brand">`) under a title, and just as readable on the page background.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/status-pills

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/status-pills.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/status-pills';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/status-pills

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
